# Castells Agency

Digital marketing agency working with contractors, home service companies and
local businesses in the United States. We build the systems that bring in work:
websites, Google Business Profile, paid advertising, and tracking that ties every
call and form back to revenue.

## Services

- [All services](https://www.castells.media/services): branding and design, development, automation and analytics, advertising and SEO
- [Industries we serve](https://www.castells.media/industries): HVAC, plumbing, roofing, remodeling, automotive services, healthcare
- [Selected work](https://www.castells.media/work): case studies with revenue and return figures
- [Blog](https://www.castells.media/blog): articles on local marketing, lead generation and automation
